title: Source-open conjugacy of the canonical stalk-comparison arrow
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime$, $g:S\prime\to S$, and $g\prime:X\prime\to X$ form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change], with derived categories and derived pullback [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, $K\prime\in D(\mathcal O_{X\prime})$, and $\phi:L(g\prime)^*K\to K\prime$, and let $c$ be any coordinates for $\phi$ [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. For an open $U\subset X$, set $j:U\to X$, $P=X\prime\times_X U$, $p:P\to X\prime$, $q:P\to U$, and take the cartesian restricted square $(q,pf\prime,jf,g)$. Put $K_U=Lj^*K$ and $K\prime_U=Lp^*K\prime$. Define $\phi_U:Lq^*K_U\to K\prime_U$ by the canonical derived pullback composition comparisons for $(q,j)$ and $(p,g\prime)$, the equation $qj=pg\prime$, and $Lp^*\phi$ [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. For any coordinates $d$ for $\phi_U$, any $z\in P$, and any $i\in\mathbb Z$, the underlying additive-group arrow of $\operatorname{stalkComparison}(c,pz,i)$ is isomorphic in the arrow category of abelian groups to the underlying additive-group arrow of the restricted $\operatorname{stalkComparison}(d,z,i)$. In particular the conclusion supplies two additive isomorphisms of sources and targets forming a commuting square; it assumes no invertibility of either comparison and no affine, boundedness, or quasi-coherence hypothesis.

proof.text: Normalize each stalkComparison by the exact-stalk homology isomorphism and its target representative isomorphism. Naturality of the homology identification followed by the coordinates represents equation proves that its normalization equals comparisonIntoPullback followed by derived-stalk cohomology of Lpullback(e);φ. This is the proved private helper open_stalkComparison_normalized.

Apply exists_open_comparisonIntoPullback_transport to c.P, d.P, their K-flatness, invertible counits and representative isomorphisms. It supplies the source isomorphism l and a natural target-cohomology isomorphism η with the comparison square before coefficients.

Postcompose this square by additive cohomology of Lp*(φ). Naturality of η moves φ across the target transport. Functor.map_comp and associativity identify β;Lp*(φ) with the exact displayed φU, so the two normalization equations give the square for c and d. Compose the original target normalization, η at K′ and the inverse restricted target normalization. Cancel the latter isomorphism and use Arrow.isoMk to package l and this target isomorphism.

theorem nonempty_stalkComparison_open_arrow_iso
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (c : Coordinates g' K K' φ)
    (U : X.Opens)
    (sqU : IsPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') (U.ι ≫ f) g) :
    let φU :=
      ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))))
        (pullback.snd g' U.ι) U.ι).hom.app K ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj K)
        (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := U.ι)).symm) ≫
      ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))))
        (pullback.fst g' U.ι) g').inv.app K ≫
      (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).map φ
    ∀ (d : Coordinates (pullback.snd g' U.ι) ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).obj K') φU)
      (z : (pullback g' U.ι : Scheme.{u})) (i : ℤ),
      Nonempty
        (Arrow.mk ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk (pullback.fst g' U.ι z)))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
              (stalkComparison f f' g g' sq c (pullback.fst g' U.ι z) i)) ≅
          Arrow.mk ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((pullback g' U.ι).presheaf.stalk z))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
              (stalkComparison (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
                g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sqU d z i)))
